en: A vintage sepia-toned postcard showing the harbor entrance of Port Said. In the foreground is calm water with a sailing vessel moored along a breakwater. At the end of the breakwater stands a prominent statue of a man on a tall pedestal, identified as the bust/statue of Ferdinand de Lesseps at the entrance to the port. Low buildings line the distant shoreline. French text appears at the top, and a modern website watermark is printed across the lower right.
